source_title: The Archimede Rover: A Comparison between Simulations and Experiments (Caruso et al., Robotics 2023, 12(5), 125)
passage_or_location: Sec 4.1 and Conclusions (OCR of PDF; reported as inequalities)
comparability_warning: Metric is odometry error, not slip; no deformable terrain in simulation; the slope/slip results (5-20 deg) are experiment-only because no simulation was run for that test mode
notes: Authors list reasons for the gap: rigid chassis, simplified terrain, bogie modelling. On slopes only experiments give slip (increase roughly exponentially with slope; ~5% median slip at 0 deg).
